providers_cmd_description: Your provider preferences, outside every project: per provider the base URL, the default model and the key name, and named openai-compatible connections (a gateway). providers list, set <provider|connection>, add <name>, remove <name>, test <provider|connection>.
providers_option_base_url: Base URL of the provider or connection (http only for loopback, unless --allow-http); an empty value goes back to the default.
providers_option_model: Default model; an empty value removes it.
providers_option_key_env: Name of the variable that holds the key (in the environment or in jgates secrets); an empty value goes back to the default.
providers_option_header: Extra header of a connection, Name=Value, repeatable; never a credential. An empty value removes them.
providers_option_allow_http: Confirms a plain http base URL to a host that is not loopback (the key would travel in clear text).
providers_unknown_action_fix: Use: jgates providers list, set <provider|connection>, add <name>, remove <name> or test <provider|connection>.
providers_unexpected_argument_fix: jgates providers list takes no argument; the other actions take only the name.
providers_unexpected_option: {name} is not used by jgates providers {action}.
providers_unexpected_option_fix: --base-url, --model, --key-env, --header and --allow-http go with set and add.
providers_missing_name: jgates providers {action} needs the name of a provider or of a connection.
providers_missing_name_fix: Use: jgates providers {action} <name> (jgates providers list shows the names).
providers_invalid_header: The header "{name}" is not in the form Name=Value.
providers_nothing_to_set_fix: Give at least one of --base-url, --model, --key-env, --header or --allow-http.
providers_add_needs_base_url: The connection {name} needs a base URL.
providers_add_needs_base_url_fix: Give it with --base-url, for example jgates providers add {name} --base-url http://localhost:4000/v1.
providers_unknown_provider: {name} is neither a provider of the semantic gate nor a connection of your preferences.
providers_unknown_provider_fix: See the names with jgates providers list; jgates providers add {name} --base-url <url> creates a connection.
providers_test_needs_base_url: {name} has no base URL to be tested.
providers_test_needs_base_url_fix: Set it first: jgates providers set {name} --base-url <url>.
providers_test_ok: {name} answers: {count} model(s) listed, no token spent.
providers_test_model_missing: The default model {model} is not in the list.
providers_test_failed_fix: Check the base URL, the key (jgates secrets set <NAME>) and the network; the test only lists the models, it sends no prompt.
providers_insecure_http_confirmed: plain http confirmed (--allow-http): the key travels in clear text
providers_list_header: Provider preferences: {path} (outside every project; the project wins over them, and jgates ci does not read them)
providers_list_problems: Entries of the file left out (fix them or set them again):
providers_add_done: Connection {name} added; its key is {key} (jgates secrets set {key}). Use it with provider: {name} in jgates.yml.
providers_remove_provider_done: Preferences of {name} removed: it is back to its defaults.
providers_remove_provider_absent: {name} has no preferences: nothing to remove.
providers_err_invalid_name: a connection name has lowercase letters, digits and "-", starts with a letter or a digit and has at most 63 characters
providers_fix_invalid_name: Choose a name such as litellm-local or team-gateway.
providers_err_name_collides: the name is a provider of the semantic gate
providers_fix_name_collides: Choose another name for the connection (jgates providers list shows the providers).
providers_err_unknown_provider: neither a provider of the semantic gate nor a connection of your preferences
providers_fix_unknown_provider: See the names with jgates providers list; jgates providers add <name> creates a connection.
providers_err_not_configurable: this provider has no preferences (it is configured in jgates.yml)
providers_err_field_not_supported: this provider does not use this field
providers_fix_field_not_supported: jgates providers list shows the fields of each provider.
providers_err_connection_exists: a connection with this name already exists
providers_fix_connection_exists: Change it with jgates providers set <name>, or remove it first with jgates providers remove <name>.
providers_err_not_found: there is no connection with this name
providers_fix_not_found: jgates providers list shows the connections.
providers_err_invalid_type: the only connection type is openai-compatible
providers_fix_invalid_type: Use a gateway that speaks the OpenAI API (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama under /v1).
providers_err_missing_base_url: a connection needs a base URL
providers_fix_missing_base_url: Give it with --base-url, for example http://localhost:4000/v1.
providers_fix_invalid_url: Give the full address, for example https://gateway.example.com/v1.
providers_err_url_scheme: only http and https are accepted
providers_fix_url_scheme: Give an http or https address.
providers_err_url_credentials: a user or a password in the URL is refused: the key goes in the key store
providers_fix_url_credentials: Remove them from the URL and store the key with jgates secrets set <NAME>.
providers_err_url_query: a query string or a fragment in the URL is refused
providers_fix_url_query: Give the base address only, without ? or #.
providers_err_insecure_http: plain http to a host that is not loopback would send the key in clear text
providers_fix_insecure_http: Use https, or confirm plain http explicitly with --allow-http.
providers_err_invalid_key_name: a key name has capital letters, digits and "_" and does not start with a digit
providers_fix_invalid_key_name: Use the name of the variable, for example LITELLM_API_KEY.
providers_err_invalid_model: a model is a non-empty text of at most 200 characters, with no line break
providers_fix_invalid_model: jgates providers test <name> lists the models of the provider.
providers_fix_invalid_header_name: Use letters, digits and "-", for example X-Team.
providers_err_invalid_header_value: a header value is a text of at most 1024 characters, with no line break
providers_err_credential_header: a header that carries a credential is refused: the key goes in the key store
providers_fix_credential_header: Store the key with jgates secrets set <NAME> and name it with --key-env <NAME>; it is sent as the Authorization header.
providers_err_reserved_header: this header is set by the semantic gate itself
providers_fix_reserved_header: Remove it from the extra headers.
providers_err_preferences_unreadable: the preferences file cannot be read
providers_fix_preferences_unreadable: Check the file named above: fix the JSON or remove it.
providers_err_preferences_blocked: the user's preferences are not used here: only the project and the environment count
providers_fix_preferences_blocked: Put the setting in the CI policy or in the environment of the pipeline.
providers_err_preferences_write_failed: the preferences file cannot be written
providers_fix_preferences_write_failed: Check the permissions of the folder named above.
